ignore.reason: Error messages and details are free text; the error code is compared.
Clients do not read sqlType, and AGOL writes sqlTypeOther for almost every field.
The GeoParquet copy keeps values only: no field defaults, and Shape__Area/Shape__Length are plain fields, not AGOL's computed shape fields.
These describe the hosted item: its text, edit history, indexes, popups and default symbol. Symbols here come from renders.
Capabilities this server does not implement (editing, curves, attachments, analytics, export, sync, collation). It reports them as unsupported or leaves them out.
AGOL does not refresh a hosted layer's extent (here null, one segment, or an older boundary); returnExtentOnly is compared instead.

known.reason: A point given as text (geometry=x,y) is read as no geometry, so the query is not filtered at all.
distance and units only widen the row-group prefilter; the exact test uses the bare point.
An unknown field in where, outFields, orderByFields or outStatistics is not an error: where matches nothing, outFields and orderByFields are dropped, and the statistic is empty.
Esri's hosted layers compare and sort strings case-insensitively (collation caseSensitive false). We compare with = and sort byte by byte.
spatialRel=esriSpatialRelWithin with a point inside a polygon feature finds nothing.
stddev is the population standard deviation; Esri's is the sample one. var matches.
min and max of a string field are left out.
Statistics fields are not typed by their source: count is a double (Esri: integer), min and max of an integer field are doubles, and string and date results have no length.
The default outStatisticFieldName is count_feature_id; Esri's is COUNT_OBJECTID.
Statistics answers carry Koop's displayFieldName and leave out objectIdFieldName, uniqueIdField, geometryType and spatialReference.
returnCountOnly with returnDistinctValues counts rows, not distinct values.
f=geojson: features have no id, have no type when outFields is not *, and a count is {"count": n} where Esri writes a FeatureCollection with properties.count.
outFields names are case-sensitive; Esri matches them in any case.
outSR other than 4326, 4269 and Web Mercator is a 400.
Fields follow the schema order; Esri lists them in outFields order.
f=pbf lists fields in alphabetical order, not schema order.
outSR=3857 is answered as wkid 3857, where Esri writes 102100 with latestWkid 3857. Extents and f=pbf leave out latestWkid, and the layer has no spatialReference.
A GlobalID field cannot be declared, so it is a string field and globalIdFieldName is empty.
String fields have length 128 and date fields 36, and every field is nullable false. Esri gives the real lengths (dates 8) and nullable true.
The layer says supportsCoordinatesQuantization false and supportedQueryFormats "JSON,geojson,PBF", though quantization works.
The layer reports 2000 for every page size; tileMaxRecordCount is not TILE_MAX_RECORDS.
displayField is the id field; Esri names a text field.
Only four spatialRel values are supported (README).
